name: Accelerated Decomposition
descr:
**Mystery**
Blight

---

You speed the natural process of a creature’s decline and debilitation. As its body withers, the target takes 9d6 [void](/trait/void) damage and must attempt a Fortitude save.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target takes half damage and is your choice of [clumsy](/condition/clumsy-player-core) 1, [drained](/condition/drained-player-core) 1, or [enfeebled](/condition/enfeebled-player-core) 1 for 1 round.

**Failure** The target takes full damage and is clumsy 1, drained 1, and enfeebled 1 for 1 round.

**Critical Failure** The creature takes double damage and is clumsy 1, drained 1, and enfeebled 1 for 1 minute.

---
**Heightened (+1)** The void damage increases by 1d6.

name: Acid Storm
descr:
**Deities**
Moloch, [Thuskchoon](/deity/thuskchoon-everglutton-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-586), [Trelmarixian](/deity/trelmarixian-the-lysogenic-prince-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-393)

**Area** 20-foot [burst](/rule/burst-rules-2385)

**Defense**
[basic](/rule/basic-saving-throws-rules-2297) reflex

---

You evoke a storm of acid rain that pelts the area for the spell’s duration. A creature that begins its turn in the area takes 3d8 [acid](/trait/acid) damage (basic Reflex save).

---
**Heightened (+2)** The damage increases by 1d8.

name: Acidic Burst
descr:
**Deities**
[Geryon](/deity/geryon-the-serpent-source-of-lies-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-398), [Oaur-Ooung](/deity/oaur-ooung-the-blistering-womb-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-585)

**Area** 5-foot [emanation](/rule/emanation-rules-2387)

**Defense**
[basic](/rule/basic-saving-throws-rules-2297) reflex

---

You create a shell of [acid](/trait/acid) around yourself that immediately bursts outward, dealing 2d6 acid damage to each creature in the area with a basic Reflex save.

---
**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 2d6.

name: Adapt Self
descr:
**Domain**
[Change](/domain/change-divine-mysteries-domain-domain-102)

---

You make subtle changes to your body to adapt to the situation. Choose one of the following options that applies to you.

- If you are in water, you gain a [swim Speed](/rule/swim-speed-rules-2351) equal to half your Speed.
- If you are in water, you become able to breathe water.
- If it’s too dark for you to see, you gain [darkvision](/rule/darkvision-and-greater-darkvision-rules-2410).
- If you are in an environment of [severe heat](/rule/temperature-rules-2820) or severe cold, you are protected from the effects of severe heat or severe cold, and the spell lasts 10 minutes.

name: Adaptive Ablation
descr:
**Domain**
[Change](/domain/change-divine-mysteries-domain-domain-102)

---

You shift yourself to adapt to the mystical wavelengths of the energy damage, protecting yourself from further harm. You gain [resistance](/rule/immunity-weakness-and-resistance-rules-2312) 5 to the triggering energy type; you gain this resistance after you take the triggering damage, so it applies only to future damage you take during the duration.

---
**Heightened (+2)** The resistance increases by 5.

name: Agitate
descr:
**Deities**
[Alglenweis](/deity/alglenweis-princess-of-the-rime-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-605), [Laivatiniel](/deity/laivatiniel-the-chains-and-the-cradle-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-419)

---

You send the target’s mind and body into overdrive, forcing it to become restless and hyperactive. During the duration, the target must [Stride](/action/stride-player-core), [Fly](/action/fly-player-core), or [Swim](/action/swim-player-core) at least once each turn or take 2d8 [mental](/trait/mental) damage at the end of its turn. The GM might decide to add additional move actions to the list for creatures that possess only a more unusual form of movement. The duration of this effect depends on the target’s Will save.

**Critical Success** The spell has no effect.

**Success** The duration is 1 round.

**Failure** The duration is 2 rounds.

**Critical Failure** The duration is 4 rounds.

---
**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 2d8.

name: Animus Mine
descr:
**Deities**
[Arazni](/deity/arazni-the-unyielding-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-326), [Lissala](/deity/lissala-the-order-of-virtue-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-407), [Nyarlathotep (The Faceless Sphinx)](/deity/nyarlathotep-the-faceless-sphinx-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-574)

---

You implant a mental mine within your psyche that detonates against anyone attempting to magically manipulate your thoughts. You can [Sustain](/action/sustain-player-core) the spell to suppress the effects of the mine for 1 round to allow someone to safely use a [mental](/trait/mental) effect on you. You can [Dismiss](/action/dismiss-player-core) the spell.

The first creature that uses a magical mental effect against you triggers the animus mine, causing the spell to end. The animus mine deals 4d8 mental damage to the triggering creature, which must attempt a Will save.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature takes half damage.

**Failure** The creature takes full damage and is [stunned](/condition/stunned-player-core) 1.

**Critical Failure** The creature takes double damage and is stunned 1. You’re unaffected by the triggering mental effect.

---
**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 2d8.

name: Anticipate Peril
descr:
**Deities**
[Alseta](/deity/alseta-the-welcomer-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-329), [Apsu](/deity/apsu-the-waybringer-draconic-codex-deity-deity-330), [Emmeton Galardaria](/deity/emmeton-galardaria-the-shared-hope-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-341), [Erecura](/deity/erecura-queen-of-dis-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-564), [Grundinnar](/deity/grundinnar-the-peacemaker-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-514), [Irez](/deity/irez-lady-of-inscribed-wonder-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-472), [Magdh](/deity/magdh-the-three-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-457), [Shyka](/deity/shyka-the-many-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-460), The Freeing Flame, [The Readied Strike](/deity/the-readied-strike-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-371), [The Spirit Wall](/deity/the-spirit-wall-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-363), Urban Prosperity, [Varg](/deity/varg-the-iron-warrior-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-561)

---

You grant the target brief foresight. The target gains a +1 status bonus to its next [initiative](/rule/initiative-rules-3300) roll, after which the spell ends.

---
**Heightened (+2)** The status bonus increases by 1, to a maximum of +4 at 7th rank.

name: Arms Of Nature
descr:
**Domain**
[Wood](/domain/wood-divine-mysteries-domain-domain-124)

---

All wood, dead or alive, is your armory. When you [Cast this Spell](/action/cast-a-spell-player-core), you draw forth a +1 weapon of your choice from the target. The weapon must be 2 Bulk or less. This weapon is of the same material as the target.

---
**Heightened (3rd)** The weapon is a _+1 [striking](/item/striking-gm-core)_ weapon.

**Heightened (5th)** The weapon is a _+2 striking_ weapon.

**Heightened (7th)** The weapon is a _+3 greater striking_ weapon.

data.targets: wooden object or plant of at least 4 Bulk

name: Ash Form
descr:
You take the form of a cloud of minuscule ash particles. You gain fast healing 3, [resistance](/rule/immunity-weakness-and-resistance-rules-2312) 10 to piercing and slashing damage, and immunity to [bleed](/condition/persistent-damage-player-core), falling damage, and precision damage. You can’t move through solid objects, but you can stream through tiny gaps as if they were [difficult terrain](/rule/difficult-terrain-rules-2366). Any ability with the [air](/trait/air) trait that involves blowing or shifting wind (such as [_gust of wind_](/spell/gust-of-wind-player-core)) deals you 1d6 bludgeoning damage per rank of the spell each round you are in its area, in addition to its normal effects.

---
**Heightened (9th)** The resistance increases to 15.

name: Ashen Wind
descr:
**Area** 10-foot [burst](/rule/burst-rules-2385)

---

You conjure a swirling wind of ashes that blows through the area. Each creature in the area must attempt a Fortitude save or get the choking ash in its lungs.

**Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Failure** The creature is [sickened](/condition/sickened-player-core) 1.

**Critical Failure** The creature is sickened 2.

name: Asterism
descr:
**Domain**
[Star](/domain/star-divine-mysteries-domain-domain-119)

**Area** five 30-foot [lines](/rule/line-rules-2388)

**Defense**
[basic](/rule/basic-saving-throws-rules-2297) reflex

---

Lines of burning starlight form a constellation around you. Draw five lines, one at a time; each line must anchor at you or a creature or object already connected to a previous line, and it must end at a creature or object within 30 feet of its anchor (possibly allowing the asterism to extend to its full 150-foot range). A creature that begins its turn in one of these lines or enters one of these lines on its turn takes 4d6 [fire](/trait/fire) damage (basic Reflex save). A creature can take this damage only once per turn, even if it moves through several lines. Targets that are part of the asterism do not take damage from it. If the distance between two targets (or you and a target) ever exceeds 30 feet, the line of starlight between the two breaks, and any lines that now no longer have a direct path back to you also break. You can [Dismiss](/action/dismiss-player-core) the spell.

---
**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d6.

name: Befuddle
descr:
**Deities**
[Areshkagal](/deity/areshkagal-the-faceless-sphinx-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-426), [Nyuo-Ogh](/deity/nyuo-ogh-the-always-observing-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-584), [The Pandemonia](/deity/the-pandemonia-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-370), [Vulot](/deity/vulot-the-all-or-none-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-439)

---

You sow seeds of confusion in your target’s mind, causing its actions and thoughts to become [clumsy](/condition/clumsy-player-core).

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target is clumsy 1 and [stupefied](/condition/stupefied-player-core) 1.

**Failure** The target is clumsy 2 and stupefied 2.

**Critical Failure** The target is clumsy 3, stupefied 3, and [confused](/condition/confused-player-core).

name: Benediction
descr:
**Area** 15-foot [emanation](/rule/emanation-rules-2387)

---

Divine protection helps protect your companions. You and your allies gain a +1 status bonus to AC while within the emanation. Once per round on subsequent turns, you can [Sustain](/action/sustain-player-core) the spell to increase the emanation’s radius by 10 feet. Benediction can counteract [_malediction_](/spell/malediction-divine-mysteries-spell-spell-2355).

name: Bottle the Storm
descr:
**Domain**
[Lightning](/domain/lightning-divine-mysteries-domain-domain-111)

---

When lightning is turned against you, you store the charge safely within yourself, unleashing it when the time is right. You gain electricity [resistance](/rule/immunity-weakness-and-resistance-rules-2312) 10 against the triggering effect. If you successfully prevent damage in this way, at any time during the spell’s duration, you can spend a single action, which has the [attack](/trait/attack) trait, to expend the charge and make a spell attack against the AC of a target within 60 feet. This attack deals electricity damage equal to the damage prevented by bottle the storm. If you Cast _bottle the storm_ a second time before the original duration elapses, or if you do not make this attack within 1 minute, the stored charge dissipates harmlessly.

---
**Heightened (7th)** The resistance increases to 15, and you can immediately make the spell attack granted by _bottle the storm_ as part of the reaction used to Cast the Spell.

**Heightened (10th)** The resistance increases to 20, and you can immediately make the spell attack granted by _bottle the storm_ as part of the reaction used to Cast the Spell.

name: Buzzing Bites
descr:
**Patron Theme**
Mosquito Witch

---

You evoke buzzing and crawling insects to climb onto a foe’s body and bite, dealing 1d4 piercing damage and potentially sickening the foe, depending on its Fortitude save. Once this spell ends, the target becomes temporarily immune for 1 minute.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target takes half damage.

**Failure** The target takes full damage.

**Critical Failure** The target takes double damage and is [sickened](/condition/sickened-player-core) 1 by the crawling insects. The sickened value can’t be reduced below 1 while the spell is active.

---
**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d4.

name: Charged Javelin
descr:
**Domain**
[Lightning](/domain/lightning-divine-mysteries-domain-domain-111)

**Defense**
AC

---

You fire a javelin of electricity that leaves a charged field around its target. Make a [spell attack](/rule/spell-attacks-rules-2248) against the target’s AC. The javelin deals 1d6 electricity damage and 1 [persistent electricity damage](/condition/persistent-damage-player-core). As long as the target is taking persistent damage from this spell, creatures gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls with [metal](/trait/metal) weapons or [electricity](/trait/electricity) effects against the target, and the target takes a –1 status penalty to saves against electricity effects.

**Critical Success** The javelin deals double damage, both initial and persistent.

**Success** The javelin deals full damage.

---
**Heightened (+1)** The initial damage increases by 1d6, and the persistent damage increases by 1.

name: Chastising Retort
descr:
**Domain**
[Naga](/domain/naga-divine-mysteries-domain-domain-113)

---

You unleash some choice words empowered with divine might. The creature takes 2d6 [mental](/trait/mental) damage and must attempt a Will save.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.
**Success** The creature takes half damage.
**Failure** The creature takes full damage and is [stupefied](/condition/stupefied-player-core) 1 for 1d4 rounds.
**Critical Failure** As failure, but the creature takes double damage and is stupefied 2 for 1d4 rounds.

The creature can immediately choose to reveal the truth about its deception as a free action to immediately recover Hit Points equal to the mental damage it took and lose the stupefied condition from the spell. If it does, it quickly notes that its words and actions were lies, though it might need more time to explain the proper truth. If the creature used Deception to successfully Feint and it reveals the truth in this way, the target of the creature’s Feint is no longer [off-guard](/condition/off-guard-player-core) due to the successful Feint.

---
**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 2d6.

data.trigger:
A creature within range attempts a Deception check
to Lie or Feint.

name: Cloak of Light
descr:
You surround yourself in holy light that restores the living and rebuffs undead. You glow with [bright light](/rule/bright-light-rules-2402) in a 30-foot radius and [dim light](/rule/dim-light-rules-2403) to the next 30 feet. Living creatures that begin their turn adjacent to you recover 4d6 Hit Points. [Undead](/trait/undead) creatures that begin their turn adjacent to you take 4d6 [vitality](/trait/vitality) damage (basic Fortitude save).

---
**Heightened (+2)** The healing increases by 2d6, and the damage to undead increases by 2d6.

name: Clouded Focus
descr:
**Domain**
[Disorientation](/domain/disorientation-divine-mysteries-domain-domain-105)

---

You sharpen a creature’s senses, though more distant objects become hazy, indistinct, or muted to it. The target gains a +1 status bonus to [Perception](/rule/perception-rules-3303) checks attempted with any of its precise senses. Furthermore, any imprecise senses the target has are sharpened to [precise senses](/rule/precise-senses-rules-2406) (though they don’t receive the status bonus). However, the target can’t perceive anything beyond a range of 20 feet with any of its senses. The duration is determined by the target’s Will save. You can allow allies to choose the outcome instead of attempting a saving throw.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target is affected for 1 round.

**Failure** The target is affected for 1 minute.

**Critical Failure** As failure, but the target can’t perceive anything beyond a range of 10 feet.

---
**Heightened (3rd)** You can target up to 2 creatures.

**Heightened (6th)** You can target up to 4 creatures.

name: Confront Selves
descr:
**Domain**
[Introspection](/domain/introspection-divine-mysteries-domain-domain-110)

**Defense**
[basic](/rule/basic-saving-throws-rules-2297) will

---

You show the target the spiraling web of actions and consequences that is their life and the changes wrought by these decisions upon themselves and those around them. These events swirl around the target like shards of broken pottery. When you [Cast](/action/cast-a-spell-player-core) or [Sustain](/action/sustain-player-core) this Spell, you force the target to confront an alternate permutation of themselves, witnessing the events of their life as if they’d chosen another path. They take 4d6 [mental](/trait/mental) damage (basic Will save) and are [clumsy](/condition/clumsy-player-core) 1 until the beginning of your next turn. On a critical success, the spell ends.

---
**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d6.

name: Cup of Dust
descr:
**Deities**
Camazotz, [Nurgal](/deity/nurgal-the-shining-scourge-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-433), [Set](/deity/set-lord-of-the-dark-desert-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-641)

---

You curse the target with a thirst no drink can quench. You can [Dismiss](/action/dismiss-player-core) the spell. The target must attempt a Fortitude save.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected and is temporarily immune for 1 hour.

**Success** The creature is [fatigued](/condition/fatigued-player-core) for 1 round.

**Failure** The creature is immediately afflicted by thirst as if it hadn’t had a drink in days. It becomes fatigued and takes 1d4 damage each hour that can’t be healed until it quenches its thirst. No amount of drinking can quench the creature’s thirst during the spell’s duration.

**Critical Failure** As failure, but the creature takes 2d4 damage each hour.

---
**Heightened (+3)** The thirst becomes more unbearable, increasing the damage each hour by 1d4, or by 2d4 on a critical failure.

name: Delay Consequence
descr:
**Domain**
[Time](/domain/time-divine-mysteries-domain-domain-121)

---

You transpose the moment that the target would be injured to a point later in its timestream. Roll damage normally, but do not reduce Hit Points or apply any other effects of the attack until the spell’s duration has elapsed. When the spell ends, the target is immediately affected by the attack, taking damage and being affected by any additional effects. You can [Dismiss](/action/dismiss-player-core) this spell.

data.trigger: A creature or object within range is hit by an [attack](/trait/attack).

name: Diamond Dust
descr:
**Domain**
[Cold](/domain/cold-divine-mysteries-domain-domain-103)

**Area** 15-foot [emanation](/rule/emanation-rules-2387)

**Defense**
[basic](/rule/basic-saving-throws-rules-2297) fortitude

---

You supercool the nearby air, forming a cloud of dancing ice crystals in an emanation around you. A creature other than you that enters the area or ends its turn within the area takes 2d6 [cold](/trait/cold) damage. A creature can take this damage only once per turn. The crystals scatter and refract light; if a light effect enters diamond dust’s area, any creatures targeted by that effect gain a +2 status bonus to AC and saves against it. While the spell persists, you can activate or deactivate this aura by [Sustaining](/action/sustain-player-core) the spell. You can [Dismiss](/action/dismiss-player-core) this spell.

---
**Heightened (+2)** The damage increases by 1d6.

name: Divine Plagues
descr:
**Domain**
[Plague](/domain/plague-divine-mysteries-domain-domain-115)

---

Your deity sends wracking plagues. The target must attempt a Fortitude save. When you [Cast the Spell](/action/cast-a-spell-player-core), decide whether the disease inflicts the [clumsy](/condition/clumsy-player-core), [enfeebled](/condition/enfeebled-player-core), or [stupefied](/condition/stupefied-player-core) condition.

**Success** The target is unaffected.
**Failure** The target is afflicted with stage 1 divine plague.
**Critical Failure** The target is afflicted with stage 2 divine plague.

**Divine Plague** (disease) **Level 1**; Stage 1 clumsy 1, enfeebled 1, or stupefied 1 (1 round); **Stage 2** [slowed](/condition/slowed-player-core) 1 and clumsy 1, enfeebled 1, or stupefied 1 (1 round); **Stage 3** clumsy 1, enfeebled 1, or stupefied 1 and the target can’t recover from the condition until they are cured (1 day)

---
**Heightened (5th)** The divine plague disease gains the [virulent](/trait/virulent) trait. The condition value for the clumsy, enfeebled, or stupefied condition is 2 instead of 1.

name: Door to Beyond
descr:
**Domain**
[Nothingness](/domain/nothingness-divine-mysteries-domain-domain-114)

**Area** 20-foot [burst](/rule/burst-rules-2385)

---

Striking at thin air, you create hairline cracks in an unoccupied adjacent space that lead somewhere outside reality. Air rushes through the cracks, drawing Large or smaller creatures and objects of light Bulk or less toward the center. Large or smaller creatures in the area must attempt a Fortitude save at the start of their turn; creatures that move into the area must attempt the save upon entering. The cracks of the door to beyond are too thin for anything to fully slip through, but decompressive effects deal 4d6 slashing damage to any creature or object that ends its turn adjacent to the door. You are unaffected by your own door to beyond. You can [Dismiss](/action/dismiss-player-core) the spell.

**Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Failure** The creature is pulled 10 feet toward the door.

**Critical Failure** The creature is pulled 20 feet toward the door.

---
**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d6.

name: Draconic Barrage
descr:
**Domain**
[Dragon](/domain/dragon-divine-mysteries-domain-domain-106)

---

You shape energy into a small group of tiny dragons (or other serpentine creatures) that flit around you. Choose [fire](/trait/fire), [force](/trait/force), [mental](/trait/mental), or [spirit](/trait/spirit) damage when you [Cast the Spell](/action/cast-a-spell-player-core). For the duration of the spell, your Strikes with weapons or unarmed attacks deal 1 additional damage of the chosen type, as the dragons add their energy to your attacks. You can [Sustain](/action/sustain-player-core) the spell to change the damage type. In addition, you can Sustain the spell to have the dragons fly off to bombard a creature within 60 feet. That creature takes 2d4 damage of the chosen type (basic Reflex save). Once the dragons have been used in this way, they wink out of existence and the spell ends.

---
**Heightened (+1)** The additional amount of damage from the dragons increases by 1 and the damage dealt by the dragons' bombardment increases by 2d4.

name: Dust Storm
descr:
**Domain**
[Dust](/domain/dust-divine-mysteries-domain-domain-107)

**Area** 20-foot [burst](/rule/burst-rules-2385)

---

You call forth a swirling storm of dust. The dust storm obscures vision, as the effects of mist. The dust also makes the air unbreathable; creatures in the area must [hold their breath](/rule/drowning-and-suffocating-rules-2439), though wearing a scarf or similar clothing over the mouth increases the time the creature can hold its breath by 5 rounds. Creatures entering or starting their turn in the dust storm take 1d6 slashing damage. Creatures that have the [water](/trait/water) trait or that are made primarily of liquid take double damage.

---
**Heightened (+2)** The damage increases by 1d6.

name: Dutiful Challenge
descr:
**Domain**
[Duty](/domain/duty-divine-mysteries-domain-domain-108)

---

As you challenge an enemy, you take some of its attention away from your allies. The target takes a –1 status penalty to attack rolls, damage rolls, and skill checks against creatures other than you, and you take a –1 status penalty to attack rolls, damage rolls, and skill checks against creatures other than the target. Each time a creature other than you uses a hostile action that affects the challenged enemy, the enemy can attempt a Will save. On a success, the enemy no longer takes the penalty against that creature. You can [Dismiss](/action/dismiss-player-core) the spell, and it ends automatically if you or the target is defeated

---
**Heightened (+3)** The status penalties increase by 1.

name: Ectoplasmic Interstice
descr:
**Domain**
[Soul](/domain/soul-divine-mysteries-domain-domain-118)

**Area** 15-foot [burst](/rule/burst-rules-2385)

---

You force the mortal Universe and Ethereal Planes to partially merge, creating a zone that causes incorporeal and spiritual entities to take on many of the aspects of corporeal creatures. Within the area of effect, [incorporeal](/trait/incorporeal) creatures can’t pass through solid objects or corporeal creatures, and they can manipulate and attempt Strength-based checks against physical creatures and objects. An incorporeal PC or other creature with a normal Strength modifier simply uses that modifier, but if the creature had a Strength modifier of –5, like most incorporeal monsters, it uses a +4 modifier instead, increasing its Athletics modifier by 9 accordingly. Attacks against creatures that are within the area overcome [resistances](/rule/immunity-weakness-and-resistance-rules-2312) as if they were by [ghost touch](/item/ghost-touch-gm-core) weapons.

name: Eject Soul
descr:
**Domain**
[Soul](/domain/soul-divine-mysteries-domain-domain-118)

---

Your touch disrupts the connection between body and soul, possibly forcing the soul out of the body altogether. The target must attempt a Fortitude save. You can allow allies to choose the degree of success instead of rolling a saving throw.

**Success** The target is unaffected.

**Failure** The target is [stunned](/condition/stunned-player-core) 1 as its soul briefly loses its connection to their body.

**Critical Failure** The target’s soul exits its body and the target’s body becomes stunned for 1 round. While their body is stunned in this way, the target remains fully aware in soul form; they simply can’t consciously move their body (though the body makes basic instinctual defensive movements). The target’s soul has the [incorporeal](/trait/incorporeal) trait, is [invisible](/condition/invisible-player-core), and has a [fly Speed](/rule/fly-speed-rules-2350) of 60 feet. It can’t [attack](/trait/attack), [cast spells](/action/cast-a-spell-player-core), or attempt any skill checks that require a physical body, and it must always maintain line of effect to the target’s body. When the target’s body ceases being stunned, the target’s soul instantly returns to their body as the target wakes.

---
**Heightened (+3)** If a willing ally chooses to critically fail, they can stay in soul form for 1 additional round.

data.targets: 1 living creature that has a soul

name: Empty Inside
descr:
**Domain**
[Nothingness](/domain/nothingness-divine-mysteries-domain-domain-114)

---

You inject a sliver of the void into your mind, momentarily remaking it into a bleak and empty place. Attempt a [counteract](/rule/counteracting-rules-3280) check against one [emotion](/trait/emotion) effect affecting you.

---
**Heightened (5th)** You can attempt counteract checks against any number of emotion effects affecting you.

name: Endure
descr:
**Deities**
[Arazni](/deity/arazni-the-unyielding-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-326), [Arqueros](/deity/arqueros-the-golden-bulwark-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-645), [Embaral](/deity/embaral-the-flooded-heart-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-340), [Fandarra](/deity/fandarra-the-blood-mother-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-492), [Folgrit](/deity/folgrit-the-watchful-mother-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-448), [Grask Uldeth](/deity/grask-uldeth-the-uniter-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-555), [Haggakal](/deity/haggakal-father-moon-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-493), [Immaculate Growth](/deity/immaculate-growth-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-364), [Izuyaku](/deity/izuyaku-the-strength-and-serenity-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-348), [Lorris](/deity/lorris-the-savior-hound-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-477), [Narakaas](/deity/narakaas-the-cleansing-sentence-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-672), The Last Breath, [Thuskchoon](/deity/thuskchoon-everglutton-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-586), [Trudd](/deity/trudd-the-mighty-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-451), [Vonymos](/deity/vonymos-the-mourning-storm-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-553)

---

You invigorate the touched creature’s mind and urge it to press on. You grant the touched creature 5 [temporary Hit Points](/rule/temporary-hit-points-rules-2321) that last for 1 minute.

---
**Heightened (+1)** The temporary Hit Points increase by 5.

name: Entreat Spirit
descr:
You invite a spirit you’ve bonded with to bolster your mind. You gain a +1 status bonus to an Intelligence-, Wisdom-, or Charisma-based skill of your choice. Additionally, you gain a +1 status bonus to saving throws against [curse](/trait/curse), [death](/trait/death), [emotion](/trait/emotion), and [fear](/trait/fear) effects.

---
**Heightened (4th)** The status bonus to the skill and your saving throws increases to +2.

**Heightened (8th)** The status bonus to the skill and your saving throws increases to +3.

data.requirements: You must be Bonded with a Spirit

name: Entreat the Many
descr:
**Area** 10-foot [emanation](/rule/emanation-rules-2387)

---

You manifest echoes of all the spirits you’ve ever bonded with at once, in a spiraling cyclone of colorful forms. They deal 8d8 [force](/trait/force) damage to each enemy in the area, with a basic Fortitude save. Additionally, creatures that critically fail the save are knocked [prone](/condition/prone-player-core).

---
**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d8.

name: Ephemeral Hazards
descr:
**Domain**
[Disorientation](/domain/disorientation-divine-mysteries-domain-domain-105)

---

You create illusory hazards, such as spinning blades or a puddle of acid, in four 10-foot-by–10-foot spaces within range. The hazards are merely a mental projection, and a creature receives a Will save each time it touches a hazard or is occupying one’s space at the start of its turn. Depending on the result, the creature takes 4d6 [mental](/trait/mental) damage and might have difficulty moving through the area. A creature can take this damage only once per turn, even if it moves through several hazards. Choose bludgeoning, slashing, piercing, [acid](/trait/acid), [cold](/trait/cold), [electricity](/trait/electricity), [fire](/trait/fire), or [sonic](/trait/sonic) damage when you Cast ephemeral hazards; resistances and weaknesses to those damage types apply if the target thinks they do, as judged by the GM. You can freely choose the appearance and damage type of each hazard as long as its appearance reflects the type of damage it deals (for instance, a [hazard](/rule/hazards-rules-2576) that deals piercing damage might take the form of sharpened spikes).

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected by the hazards and no longer needs to attempt Will saves against them.

**Success** The creature realizes the hazards aren’t real but still takes half damage from them; on future Will saves against the hazards, the creature continues to use this result unless it rolls a critical success.

**Failure** The target takes full damage and treats the square as difficult terrain.

**Critical Failure** The target takes double damage and can’t pass through a square containing a hazard.

---
**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d6.

name: Expeditious Excavation
descr:
**Deities**
[Kabriri](/deity/kabriri-him-who-gnaws-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-432), [Magrim](/deity/magrim-the-taskmaster-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-450), [Sairazul](/deity/sairazul-the-crystalline-queen-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-694)

---

You remove loose dirt, dust, gravel, sand, and the like (though not solid stone) up to the size of a 5-foot cube. Any Medium or smaller creature standing atop the earth when the spell is cast must attempt a Reflex save or Acrobatics check.

**Success** The creature is unaffected and can choose to either descend the pit without damage or move to the nearest available space of its choice.

**Failure** The creature falls [prone](/condition/prone-player-core) in the nearest available space of its choice or falls into the pit if it prefers.

**Critical Failure** The creature falls into the pit excavated by the spell and lands prone, taking falling damage as normal.

---
**Heightened (+2)** The spell can excavate an additional 5-foot cube of earth. If you excavate all four 5-foot cubes beneath a Large creature, it must attempt a Reflex save or Acrobatics check, as above.

data.area: cube of dirt 5 feet across or smaller

name: Fallow Field
descr:
**Domain**
[Decay](/domain/decay-divine-mysteries-domain-domain-104)

**Area** 15-foot [burst](/rule/burst-rules-2385)

---

A sickly yellow light fills the area as entropic forces prevent [healing](/trait/healing). When a creature within the area would regain Hit Points, such as from a healing effect or an ability like fast healing or regeneration, it must attempt a Will save.

**Critical Success** The creature regains the full number of Hit Points that would be restored by the healing effect and is temporarily immune for 1 minute.

**Success** The creature regains the full number of Hit Points that would be restored.

**Failure** The creature regains only half the number of Hit Points that would be restored.

**Critical Failure** The creature doesn’t regain Hit Points from the healing effect.

name: Fear the Sun
descr:
You cause the creature’s vision to become particularly sensitive. The creature must attempt a Fortitude save. The creature is then temporarily immune for 1 minute.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected

**Success** The creature is [dazzled](/condition/dazzled-player-core) for 1 round.

**Failure** The creature is dazzled for 1 minute.

**Critical Failure** The creature gains light blindness for 1 minute. If the creature is already exposed to [bright light](/rule/bright-light-rules-2402), it immediately becomes [blinded](/condition/blinded-player-core) until the end of its next turn, as it isn’t acclimated to its newly acquired light blindness.

---
**Heightened (6th)** You can target up to 10 creatures.

name: Fearful Feast
descr:
**Domain**
[Abomination](/domain/abomination-divine-mysteries-domain-domain-101)

---

You open your mouth wide and inhale sharply; you draw in the bravery, self-confidence, and hope to which the frightened target clings and then strip away the target’s false assumption that these fragile emotions can save them from the oblivion of terror. You deal 6d4 [mental](/trait/mental) damage to the creature, which must attempt a Will saving throw.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature takes half damage.

**Failure** The creature takes full damage; you regain Hit Points equal to half the damage the target takes.

**Critical Failure** The creature’s frightened condition increases by 1 (to a maximum of frightened 4) and it takes double damage; you regain Hit Points equal to half the damage the target takes.

---
**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d4.

name: Feast of Ashes
descr:
**Deities**
[Fumeiyoshi](/deity/fumeiyoshi-lord-of-envy-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-305), [Pavnuri](/deity/pavnuri-the-lord-of-nothing-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-420), [Thuskchoon](/deity/thuskchoon-everglutton-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-586), [Trelmarixian](/deity/trelmarixian-the-lysogenic-prince-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-393), [Xoveron](/deity/xoveron-horned-prince-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-440)

---

You curse the target with a hunger no food can sate. You can [Dismiss](/action/dismiss-player-core) the spell. The target must attempt a Fortitude save.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected and is temporarily immune for 1 hour.

**Success** The creature is [fatigued](/condition/fatigued-player-core) for 1 round.

**Failure** The creature is immediately afflicted by hunger as if it hadn’t eaten food in days. It becomes fatigued and takes 1d4 damage each day that can’t be healed until it sates its hunger. No amount of eating can sate the creature’s hunger during the spell’s duration.

**Critical Failure** As failure, but the creature takes 2d4 damage each day from unbearable hunger.

---
**Heightened (+1)** The hunger becomes more intolerable, increasing the damage each day by 1d4, or by 2d4 on a critical failure.

name: Font of Serenity
descr:
**Domain**
[Repose](/domain/repose-divine-mysteries-domain-domain-116)

**Area** 15-foot [burst](/rule/burst-rules-2385)

---

A divine beacon radiates serenity, soothing nearby allies. Allies within the area gain a +1 status bonus to saving throws against [emotion](/trait/emotion) effects. An ally can touch the font at the center of the burst as an [Interact](/action/interact-player-core) action; if they do so, the spell attempts to [counteract](/rule/counteracting-rules-3280) one emotion effect affecting the ally of the ally’s choice, after which that emotion effect is temporarily immune for 1 day. If the spell succeeds at the counteract check, it removes the emotion effect from your ally, though not from any other creatures the effect might be affecting.

---
**Heightened (+4)** The bonus increases by 1.

name: Foul Miasma
descr:
**Domain**
[Plague](/domain/plague-divine-mysteries-domain-domain-115)

---

You multiply the disease within a creature, drawing it into an infectious mist outside their body where it can spread to other creatures. The target must attempt a Will save. If the target is willing, it can choose to take the effects of critical failure.

**Critical Success** The target receives the benefit of a successful save against the lowest-level disease affecting it.

**Success** The target is unaffected.

**Failure** One randomly chosen disease affecting the target fills the air in a 15-foot emanation centered on the target. For the spell’s duration, any creature that enters or ends its turn within the area is exposed to that disease.

**Critical Failure** As failure, except the miasma contains all the diseases affecting the target.

name: Fungal Hyphae
descr:
**Deity**
[Cyth-V’sug](/deity/cyth-vsug-prince-of-the-blasted-heath-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-428)

---

Thin hyphae grow from your feet and plunge into the earth, creating a symbiotic fungal network that attaches to plants within 30 feet and connects you to their root systems. You gain an [imprecise](/rule/imprecise-senses-rules-2407) [tremorsense](/rule/tremorsense-rules-2413), allowing you to sense anything directly touching plants within that distance. If you move, the hyphae snap, and the spell ends.

---
**Heightened (4th)** You can control plants in the area to a small degree, allowing you to make [Strikes](/rule/strikes-rules-2895) with tree branches, exposed roots, or similarly solid plants. To do so, you use a [Strike](/action/strike-player-core) action, but you can Strike any creature you can detect with your tremorsense. These are spell attacks that deal 3d8 bludgeoning damage. Unusual plants, such as thorny vines, might deal a different type of damage at the GM’s discretion. You can’t make any other attacks through these plants, or take any other actions through them, other than these Strikes.

**Heightened (6th)** As 4th rank, but you can use other simple [manipulate](/trait/manipulate) actions through the plants, including having a branch pick an object up or open a door, though more complex actions, such as picking a lock or disabling a trap, remain impossible.

name: Ghostly Transcription
descr:
**Domain**
[Glyph](/domain/glyph-divine-mysteries-domain-domain-109)

---

Glowing letters assemble in the air, providing a transcription of the target’s speech in all languages you speak. For the spell’s duration, any words spoken aloud by the target are spelled out in letters in front of them. When you [Cast the Spell](/action/cast-a-spell-player-core), you can choose whether these letters are visible to all creatures or only certain creatures you specify. Any words the target mouths silently are similarly spelled out, allowing the target to communicate silently or in areas where sound doesn’t carry. This even allows the target to utter the incantations necessary for spells in such areas, but only if you choose to make the letters visible to all creatures. Furthermore, any of the target’s [auditory](/trait/auditory) abilities can affect creatures even in areas where sound doesn’t carry as long as you have made the glyphs visible to them and they have line of sight to the target; in this case, they gain the [visual](/trait/visual) trait. You can [Dismiss](/action/dismiss-player-core) the spell.

name: Glamorize
descr:
Using simple magical gestures, you alter a minor detail of your appearance (add or remove highlights to your hair color, apply or remove cosmetics, add polish or accessories to your nails, etc.) or create a small environmental effect that’s confined to your person (adjust surrounding lighting to favor your good side, cause a brief wind to make your hair blow dramatically, make a small chime occur as you smile, etc.). While the spell is active, you can [Sustain](/action/sustain-player-core) it to make further adjustments. The changes persist until the spell’s duration ends.

At the GM’s discretion, such alterations might grant a +1 status bonus to certain tasks, such as [Impersonate](/action/impersonate-player-core) or [Perform](/action/perform-player-core).

name: Guided Introspection
descr:
**Domain**
[Introspection](/domain/introspection-divine-mysteries-domain-domain-110)

---

You guide the target in examining their innermost feelings, their behaviors, and the motivations behind their actions, granting them clarity and insight. The target gains a +1 status bonus to saving throws against [emotion](/trait/emotion) and [fear](/trait/fear). If the target would become [confused](/condition/confused-player-core) during the spell’s duration, they reduce the duration of the confused condition by 1 round, to a minimum of 1 round. If the target would become [frightened](/condition/frightened-player-core) or [stupefied](/condition/stupefied-player-core), they reduce the value of the frightened or stupefied condition by 1, to a minimum of 1. Once any of these conditions occur, the spell ends.

---
**Heightened (4th)** The status bonus increases to +2.

name: Incendiary Ashes
descr:
**Area** 20-foot [burst](/rule/burst-rules-2385)

---

A cloud of magical ashes descends upon creatures in the area. The ashes scour flesh and linger in the wounds, igniting upon the slightest flicker of flame. Creatures in the area take 4d6 slashing damage and must attempt a Fortitude save.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature takes half damage and has [weakness](/rule/immunity-weakness-and-resistance-rules-2312) to [fire](/trait/fire) 3 until the start of its next turn.

**Failure** The creature takes full damage and has weakness to fire 3 for 1 minute. If the creature is killed by fire during this time it’s reduced to ashes, though its gear remains.

**Critical Failure** As failure, except the creature takes double damage.

---
**Heightened (+1)** The slashing damage increases by 2d6 and weakness to fire increases by 1.

name: Lament
descr:
**Domain**
[Sorrow](/domain/sorrow-divine-mysteries-domain-domain-117)

**Defense**
[basic](/rule/basic-saving-throws-rules-2297) will

---

You let out your negative emotions in a guttural wail that shakes your enemies’ hearts and deals 1d8 [mental](/trait/mental) damage (basic Will save) to each creature in the area. If you have any harmful conditions imposed by [emotion](/trait/emotion) effects, lament deals additional mental damage equal to the [counteract](/rule/counteracting-rules-3280) rank of the highest-level effect.

---
**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d8.

name: Liberating Command
descr:
**Deities**
[Nameless](/deity/nameless-upon-an-empty-throne-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-598), [Ranginori](/deity/ranginori-the-zephyrous-prince-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-693), [Ristrentho](/deity/ristrentho-whose-blood-churns-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-608), [Scal](/deity/scal-calm-after-the-storm-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-410), [Shei](/deity/shei-the-ibis-matron-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-653), [Ssila’meshnik](/deity/ssilameshnik-the-colorless-lord-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-548)

---

You call out a liberating cry, urging an ally to break free of an effect that holds them in place. If the target is [grabbed](/condition/grabbed-player-core), [immobilized](/condition/immobilized-player-core), or [restrained](/condition/restrained-player-core), it can immediately use a reaction to attempt to [Escape](/action/escape-player-core).

name: Lift Nature's Caul
descr:
**Domain**
[Abomination](/domain/abomination-divine-mysteries-domain-domain-101)

**Area** 5-foot [emanation](/rule/emanation-rules-2387)

---

With a wave of the hand, you cause all creatures in the area to see the world around them as if a gauzy film had been lifted away to expose the truth that lies below their perceived reality. Natural features they can see grow twisted and horrendous, structures appear distorted and ruined, and objects seem warped and alien. This alternate vision fades quickly, but the glimpse beyond the natural world lingers for the spell’s duration.

[Aberrations](/trait/aberration) or worshippers of Outer Gods or Great Old Ones are bolstered by this vision of warped reality and gain a +1 status bonus to Will saving throws and attack rolls for 1 minute, while all other creatures must attempt a Will saving throw.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected and temporarily immune for 1 hour.

**Success** The creature is [sickened](/condition/sickened-player-core) 1.

**Failure** The creature is [stupefied](/condition/stupefied-player-core) 1 for 1 minute and [frightened](/condition/frightened-player-core) 1.

**Critical Failure** The creature is stupefied 1 for 1 minute and frightened 2. It can’t reduce the value of its frightened condition below 1 as long as it remains stupefied by this spell.

---
**Heightened (+2)** The area increases by 5 feet.

name: Malediction
descr:
**Area** 10-foot [emanation](/rule/emanation-rules-2387)

---

You incite distress in the minds of your enemies, making it more difficult for them to defend themselves. Enemies in the area must succeed at a Will save or take a –1 status penalty to AC as long as they’re in the area. Once per round on subsequent turns, you can [Sustain](/action/sustain-player-core) the spell to increase the emanation’s radius by 10 feet and force enemies in the area that weren’t yet affected to attempt a saving throw. Malediction can counteract [_benediction_](/spell/benediction-divine-mysteries-spell-spell-2345).

name: Manifold Lives
descr:
**There is a more recent version of this, click here to view.**

**Mystery**
Time

---

You cast a creature’s mind back through time, forcing them to take other paths and make other choices, experiencing countless alternate lives in an instant. The creature becomes overwhelmed with regret over paths untraveled, lives unlived, and times unrealized. The creature takes 6d6 [mental](/trait/mental) damage and must attempt a Will save. After the effect is resolved, the target is then temporarily immune for 1 day.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature takes half damage and is [stupefied](/condition/stupefied-player-core) 2 for 1 round.

**Failure** The creature takes full damage and is stupefied 2 for 1 minute. While affected, the creature must attempt another save at the start of its turn; on a failure, it’s slowed 1 for that turn as it sobs uncontrollably.

**Critical Failure** The creature takes double damage and for 1 minute, it’s stupefied 4 and [slowed](/condition/slowed-player-core) 1 as it sobs uncontrollably.

---
**Heightened (+1)** The mental damage increases by 1d6.

name: Message Rune
descr:
**Deities**
Cormigus, Lissala, Mephistopheles, Nyarlathotep (The Crawling Chaos), Nyarlathotep (The Veiled Voice), Pavnuri, Pillars of Knowledge, Thoth, Ydajisk

---

You record a message up to 5 minutes long and inscribe a special rune on any flat unattended surface or small object within reach. The nature of the rune’s appearance is up to you, but it’s visible to everyone, and it must be no smaller than 2 inches in diameter. You also specify a trigger that creatures must meet to activate the rune. For the duration of the spell, creatures that meet the criteria of the trigger can touch the rune to hear the recorded message in their head as though you were speaking to them telepathically. You know when someone is listening to the message, but you don’t know who’s listening to it. You can Dismiss the spell.

---
**Heightened (+2)** The duration increases for every 2 ranks, becoming 1 week, 1 month, 1 year, or unlimited respectively.

data.targets: 1 flat unattended surface or a non-magical object of light Bulk

name: Moonburst
descr:
**Area** 60-foot [burst](/rule/burst-rules-2385)

---

A powerful globe of chilling moonlight explodes in the area, dealing 8d10 [cold](/trait/cold) damage to all creatures in the area, plus an additional 8d10 [vitality](/trait/vitality) damage to [undead](/trait/undead) creatures. Moonburst’s cold damage is silver damage for the purposes of [weaknesses, resistances, and the like](/rule/immunity-weakness-and-resistance-rules-2312). Each creature and object in the area must attempt a Reflex save.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature takes half damage.

**Failure** The creature takes full damage.

**Critical Failure** The creature takes full damage and becomes blinded permanently.

If the globe overlaps with an area of magical [darkness](/rule/darkness-rules-2404), _moonburst_ attempts to [counteract](/rule/counteracting-rules-2250) the darkness effect.

---
**Heightened (+1)** The cold damage increases by 1d10, and the vitality damage against undead increases by 1d10.

name: Moonlight Ray
descr:
**Defense**
AC

---

You unleash a holy beam of freezing moonlight. Make a [ranged spell attack](/rule/spell-attacks-rules-2248). The ray deals 5d6 [cold](/trait/cold) damage. If the target has the [unholy](/trait/unholy) trait, you deal an extra 5d6 [spirit](/trait/spirit) damage. Moonlight ray’s cold damage is silver damage for the purposes of [weaknesses, resistances, and the like.](/rule/immunity-weakness-and-resistance-rules-2312)

**Critical Success** The target takes double damage.

**Success** The target takes full damage.

If the light passes through an area of magical [darkness](/rule/darkness-rules-2404) or targets a creature affected by magical darkness, _moonlight ray_ attempts to [counteract](/rule/counteracting-rules-3280) the darkness. If you need to determine whether the light passes through an area of darkness, draw a line between yourself and the spell’s target.

---
**Heightened (+1)** The cold damage increases by 2d6, and the spirit damage against unholy creatures increases by 2d6.

name: Object Memory
descr:
**Domain**
[Vigil](/domain/vigil-divine-mysteries-domain-domain-123)

---

By touching an object, you draw forth the experience of those who created and used it. If you touch a weapon, your proficiency rank with that weapon temporarily increases to trained (if it is not already trained or better). If you touch a tool, your proficiency rank with the next skill check you attempt with that tool (such as a Crafting check with a blacksmith’s hammer) within the spell’s duration temporarily increases to trained (if it is not already trained or better). This spell has no benefit for activities that take longer than a minute to complete.

---
**Heightened (6th)** Your proficiency rank increases to expert instead of trained.

name: Overflowing Sorrow
descr:
**Domain**
[Sorrow](/domain/sorrow-divine-mysteries-domain-domain-117)

**Area** 15-foot [emanation](/rule/emanation-rules-2387)

---

Sadness flows out of you into nearby creatures, blotting out any other thoughts they had. The first time a creature begins its turn in the area or enters the area, it must attempt a Will save. If it later leaves and reenters the area, it uses the same effect as before.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature takes a –1 status penalty to skill checks and [Perception](/rule/perception-rules-3303) checks as long as it remains in the area.

**Failure** While the creature is in the area, any emotion effects of lower counteract rank than overflowing sorrow are suppressed, and whenever the creature attempts to use an emotion action or cast an emotion spell, it must succeed at a DC 11 [flat check](/rule/checks-rules-2278) or the action or spell is disrupted.

**Critical Failure** As failure, but the creature can’t use emotion actions or spells.

---
**Heightened (+2)** When you [Cast the Spell](/action/cast-a-spell-player-core), you can choose to increase the area by 5 feet.

name: Pact Broker
descr:
**There is a more recent version of this, click here to view.**

**Patron Theme**
The Unseen Broker

---

You offer to broker a pact of peace. If the target accepts and doesn’t take hostile actions against you and your allies during the hex’s duration, you take a –1 status penalty to Deception checks to [Lie](/action/lie-player-core) to them. If they refuse and take a hostile action against you or an ally during the hex’s duration, they must first attempt a Will save. If they accepted the offer and then take a hostile action against you or an ally during the hex’s duration, they must first attempt a Will save and treat the result as one category worse. Regardless of the outcome, the target is then temporarily immune for 1 minute.

**Success** The target is unaffected.

**Failure** The target takes 2d4 [mental](/trait/mental) damage and a –1 status penalty to attack and damage rolls against you and your allies for the hex’s duration.

**Critical Failure** As failure, but the penalty is –2.

---
**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d4.

name: Parch
descr:
**Domain**
[Dust](/domain/dust-divine-mysteries-domain-domain-107)

---

Dry winds dehydrate a creature. The target must attempt a Fortitude save; if used on a creature that has the [water](/trait/water) trait or a creature made primarily of liquid (such as many oozes), the creature uses the outcome for one degree of success worse than the result. Creatures whose bodies contain no significant moisture (such as earth elementals) are immune to parch. If a creature affected by _parch_ drinks a liquid, such as a swig of water or a potion, the spell ends. Affected creatures that have the water trait or are made primarily of liquid, as well as affected creatures that can’t drink, can end the effect as a two-action activity, which has the [concentrate](/trait/concentrate) trait.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target takes a –1 status penalty to its checks and DCs for 1 round.

**Failure** The target takes a –1 status penalty to its checks and DCs for 1 minute.

**Critical Failure** The target takes a –2 status penalty to its checks and DCs for 1 minute and is [dazzled](/condition/dazzled-player-core) as long as it has this penalty.

---
**Heightened (4th)** You can target up to 4 creatures.

name: Penumbral Disguise
descr:
**Deity**
[Dajermube](/deity/dajermube-holder-of-unquenchable-light-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-338)

---

You wrap the target in shadows, granting it a +1 status bonus to Stealth checks to [Hide](/action/hide-player-core) while in [dim light](/rule/dim-light-rules-2403) or [darkness](/rule/darkness-rules-2404). In addition, the shadows mask the target’s features. While the target is in dim light or darkness, other creatures must succeed at a [Seek](/action/seek-player-core) action against the spell’s DC to discern details about its appearance. For example, without using Seek, other creatures can determine the target’s general shape (such as [humanoid](/trait/humanoid)), but they must Seek to determine the target’s precise appearance. Creatures with [darkvision](/rule/darkvision-and-greater-darkvision-rules-2410) can still see the target and its features normally. The target’s normal appearance is revealed in [bright light](/rule/bright-light-rules-2402).

---
**Heightened (4th)** The status bonus is +2. Creatures with darkvision can no longer discern details about the target while the target is in dim light or darkness without Seeking, though creatures with greater darkvision can still determine these details.

**Heightened (6th)** As 4th rank, except the status bonus is +3, and creatures without darkvision can’t determine even general details about the target while the target is in dim light or darkness unless they successfully Seek the target; these creatures see a vague shadow instead. Even on a successful Seek, they only determine general features, though they can see details on a critical success.

**Heightened (8th)** As 6th rank, except the status bonus is +4, and even creatures with greater darkvision must Seek to discern details about the target while the target is in dim light or darkness.

name: Penumbral Shroud
descr:
**Deities**
[Aleth](/deity/aleth-the-gentle-shroud-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-328), [Black Butterfly](/deity/black-butterfly-the-silence-between-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-468), [Cosmic Caravan](/deity/cosmic-caravan-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-377), [Count Ranalc](/deity/count-ranalc-the-traitor-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-452), Kerkamoth, Nocticula, [Set](/deity/set-lord-of-the-dark-desert-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-641), [Shawnari](/deity/shawnari-the-one-out-of-place-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-600), [Thamir](/deity/thamir-the-silent-blade-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-566), [The Lady of the North Star](/deity/the-lady-of-the-north-star-mother-of-secrets-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-303)

---

You envelop the target in a shroud of shadow. The target perceives [light](/rule/light-rules-2401) as one step lower than it actually is ([bright light](/rule/bright-light-rules-2402) becomes [dim light](/rule/dim-light-rules-2403), for example), affecting their ability to sense creatures and objects accordingly. The shroud also provides the target a +1 status bonus to saving throws against [light](/trait/light) effects. This effect is helpful to creatures sensitive to light, and a creature can willingly choose to be subject to the failure effect of the spell.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The effect lasts for 1 round.

**Failure** The effect lasts its normal duration.

name: Practice Makes Perfect
descr:
**Domain**
[Toil](/domain/toil-divine-mysteries-domain-domain-122)

---

The target gains a +2 status bonus to the triggering check, or a +3 bonus if the target has master or better proficiency in the skill. This bonus can change the outcome of the target’s skill check.

data.trigger: You or an ally within range fails a skill check for a skill in which you or they are trained.

name: Purging Toxins
descr:
**Mystery**
Blight

---

In the right dose, a scourge can become a cure. Deal [poison](/trait/poison) damage equal to the spell’s level to the target, then attempt a [counteract](/rule/counteracting-rules-3280) check against one [disease](/rule/diseases-rules-2767) or poison afflicting the target. The target is then temporarily immune for 24 hours. If the target is [immune](/rule/immunity-weakness-and-resistance-rules-2312) to poison, this spell has no effect.

---
**Heightened (5th)** You can attempt counteract checks against any number of poisons or diseases afflicting the target.

name: Radiant Field
descr:
**Area** 20-foot [burst](/rule/burst-rules-2385)

---

You create an area of [bright light](/rule/bright-light-rules-2402). Creatures with light blindness that are [blinded](/condition/blinded-player-core) by radiant field and remain in the area must attempt a Fortitude save at the start of their turns. On a failure, a creature remains blinded for 1 round; this is an [incapacitation](/trait/incapacitation) effect. This spell also suppresses magical [darkness](/rule/darkness-rules-2404) of your radiant field spell’s rank or lower.

---
**Heightened (4th)** Creatures seen through the area are [concealed](/condition/concealed-player-core) to creatures outside the area. Creatures with light blindness can continue to be blinded by the field as long as the field is visible, even when outside of the field.

name: Redact
descr:
**Domain**
[Glyph](/domain/glyph-divine-mysteries-domain-domain-109)

---

You strike mention of a specific name from one or more documents. When you [Cast the Spell](/action/cast-a-spell-player-core), give one proper name, be it a creature, location, or object. Any mention of that name within the document becomes blurred, smudged, or otherwise completely illegible. Epithets and unambiguous references to the name are redacted as well; for instance, redacting the name of the goddess [Sarenrae](/deity/sarenrae-the-dawnflower-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-292) from a book would also remove references to her title “the Dawnflower.” Attempts to use this reference material to [Recall Knowledge](/rule/recall-knowledge-rules-2638) about the given proper name automatically fail.

---
**Heightened (3rd)** Instead of striking out a given name, you can replace it with a different name you choose. Epithets and references are substituted with similar ones relating to the replacement name. Anyone reading the text can attempt a Perception or Society check against your spell DC to notice the altered text, though that doesn’t tell them what the original said.

**Heightened (4th)** At your choice, the duration is unlimited.

data.targets: unattended written materials of up to 1 Bulk

name: Reflective Scales
descr:
**Deities**
[Abraxas](/deity/abraxas-master-of-the-final-incantation-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-425), [Anogetz](/deity/anogetz-the-fated-fangs-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-416), [Irez](/deity/irez-lady-of-inscribed-wonder-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-472), [Nalinivati](/deity/nalinivati-the-serpent-s-kiss-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-313), [Shizuru](/deity/shizuru-ruler-of-heaven-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-315), [Wadjet](/deity/wadjet-the-green-empress-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-643)

---

You grow a set of colored, glowing scales or scaled armor that stores energy before releasing it in a final burst. When you cast this spell, choose [acid](/trait/acid), [cold](/trait/cold), [fire](/trait/fire), [electricity](/trait/electricity), or [poison](/trait/poison) damage. You gain [resistance](/rule/immunity-weakness-and-resistance-rules-2312) 5 against that type of damage. The scales’ color depends on the damage type you chose, such as red or orange for fire damage.

The scales store up energy as they protect you. Keep track of how much damage the scales have prevented. As a 2-action activity that has the [concentrate](/trait/concentrate) and [manipulate](/trait/manipulate) traits, you can explode your scales outward in a 20-foot emanation, dealing 1d6 damage of the chosen type to all creatures in the area for every 10 damage the scales have prevented, to a maximum of 10d6 damage (after preventing 100 damage). Each creature in the area must attempt a [basic](/rule/basic-saving-throws-rules-2247) Reflex save. Once you do so, the spell ends.

---
**Heightened (+2)** The resistance increases by 5, and the maximum damage from the scale explosion increases by 5d6.

name: Remember the Lost
descr:
**Domain**
[Vigil](/domain/vigil-divine-mysteries-domain-domain-123)

**Area** 30-foot [emanation](/rule/emanation-rules-2387)

---

You call upon the lost and forgotten, assailing your foes’ minds with the memories of those who died with a grievance toward them. Enemies in the area take 6d6 [mental](/trait/mental) damage (basic Will save) and are [frightened](/condition/frightened-player-core) 1 on a critical failure. If you know the names of anyone murdered or grievously wronged by an enemy in the area, you can chant those victims’ names when you [Cast the Spell](/action/cast-a-spell-player-core) to improve the clarity of the visions, increasing the damage to the corresponding enemy from 6d6 to 6d10; you can do so for multiple enemies if you know specific victims of each enemy. The visions are personal to each foe in the area, and you can’t use this spell to discern a murderer by guessing a name. A creature that truly knows no one who died with any sort of grievance to that creature is [immune](/rule/immunity-weakness-and-resistance-rules-2312) to this effect.

---
**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 2d6 (or 2d10 to an enemy when you name a specific victim).

name: Repel Metal
descr:
**Domain**
[Metal](/domain/metal-divine-mysteries-domain-domain-112)

---

You call forth a repelling field. The target gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack. If the attack then misses, you direct the Strike back at the attacker, who compares the attack roll to their own AC. The target then becomes immune to this spell for 10 minutes.

data.targets: the creature targeted by the triggering Strike
data.trigger: A [Strike](/action/strike-player-core) with a metallic weapon or projectile would hit you or an ally within range.

name: Roar of the Dragon
descr:
**Domain**
[Dragon](/domain/dragon-divine-mysteries-domain-domain-106)

**Area** 30-foot [emanation](/rule/emanation-rules-2387)

---

You channel the might of dragons into your voice, letting out a roar that engenders respect in dragonkind but that instills fear in most other creatures. The impressive roar grants you a +2 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy checks for 10 minutes against dragons that were in the area at the time of casting. _Roar of the dragon_ affects non-dragon creatures with deep ties to dragonkind (such as a [barbarian](/class/barbarian-player-core-2) with the draconic instinct, a sorcerer with the draconic bloodline, or a member of a culture that reveres dragons) as if they had the [dragon](/trait/dragon) trait. The GM decides if a creature is aligned enough with dragonkind to be affected in this way. All enemies within the area other than dragons must attempt a Will save; to these enemies, _roar of the dragon_ is a [fear](/trait/fear) effect.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature is [frightened](/condition/frightened-player-core) 1.

**Failure** The creature is frightened 2.

**Critical Failure** The creature is frightened 3 and [fleeing](/condition/fleeing-player-core) for 1 round.

name: Serrate
descr:
**Domain**
[Metal](/domain/metal-divine-mysteries-domain-domain-112)

---

With a pinch, the metal of a weapon twists, adding numerous jagged blades along its surface. [Strikes](/action/strike-player-core) with the target weapon deal an additional 1d4 slashing damage until the start of your next turn.

---
**Heightened (+2)** The extra damage increases by 1d4.

name: Share Burden
descr:
**Domain**
[Repose](/domain/repose-divine-mysteries-domain-domain-116)

---

You shoulder some of your ally’s pain. Both you and your ally use the outcome one degree of success better than the result of your ally’s saving throw, even if the triggering effect usually affects only one target.

data.trigger: An ally within range is about to attempt a saving throw against a harmful [emotion](/trait/emotion) effect, and you would not otherwise have to save against the effect.

name: Share Lore
descr:
**Deities**
[Abraxas](/deity/abraxas-master-of-the-final-incantation-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-425), [Gruhastha](/deity/gruhastha-the-keeper-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-346), [Matravash](/deity/matravash-the-wide-water-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-617), [Mazludeh](/deity/mazludeh-mother-of-hearth-and-wall-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-680), Nin, [Saloc](/deity/saloc-the-minder-of-immortals-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-547), The Endless Road, The Enlightened Scholar's Path, [Vale](/deity/vale-the-court-of-ancestors-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-551), [Winlas](/deity/winlas-the-elder-of-divinity-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-656), [Zohls](/deity/zohls-verity-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-489)

**Patron Theme**
Choir Politic

---

You share your knowledge with the touched creatures. Choose one Lore skill in which you’re trained. The targets become trained in that Lore skill for the duration of the spell.

---
**Heightened (3rd)** The duration of the spell is 1 hour, and you can target up to five creatures.

**Heightened (5th)** The duration of the spell is 8 hours, you can target up to five creatures, and you can share up to two Lore skills in which you’re trained.

name: Share Vision
descr:
**Patron Theme**
Choir Politic

---

Your patron temporarily links your vision with that of another, causing both of you to be able to see through each other’s eyes. For the duration of the hex, the two of you share any vision-based senses (such as [darkvision](/rule/darkvision-and-greater-darkvision-rules-2410) or [low-light vision](/rule/low-light-vision-rules-2411)) and gain a +2 status bonus to Perception checks, but if either of you are [blinded](/condition/blinded-player-core) or [dazzled](/condition/dazzled-player-core), you both are.

If you cast _share vision_ while a previous casting of this hex is still in effect, the previous effect ends.

name: Shattering Gem
descr:
**Deities**
[Ashukharma](/deity/ashukharma-the-divine-divide-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-611), [Mammon](/deity/mammon-the-argent-prince-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-399), [Sairazul](/deity/sairazul-the-crystalline-queen-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-694), The Resplendent Court, [Yuelral](/deity/yuelral-the-wise-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-463)

---

A large gem floats around the target in an erratic pattern. The gem has 5 Hit Points. Each time a creature [Strikes](/rule/strikes-rules-2895) the target, the target attempts a DC 11 flat check. On a success, the gem blocks the attack, so the attack first damages the gem and then applies any remaining damage to the target. If the gem is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it shatters, immediately dealing 1d8 slashing damage (basic Reflex save) to the creature that destroyed it, as long as that creature is within 10 feet of the target.

---
**Heightened (+1)** The gem has 5 additional Hit Points, and the damage dealt by its detonation increases by 1d8.

name: Shifting Sand
descr:
**Deities**
[Anubis](/deity/anubis-guardian-of-the-tomb-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-511), [Yamatsumi](/deity/yamatsumi-the-mountain-lord-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-319), [Zipacna](/deity/zipacna-the-mountain-below-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-604)

**Area** a horizontal earthen or sandy surface within a 20-foot [burst](/rule/burst-rules-2385)

---

You cause the surface to heave. The area becomes [difficult terrain](/rule/difficult-terrain-rules-2586), and any tracks in the area are destroyed by the churning ground. Creatures standing in the area take a –1 status penalty to Acrobatics checks to [Balance](/action/balance-player-core) and [Tumble Through](/action/tumble-through-player-core) and Athletics checks to [High Jump](/action/high-jump-player-core) and [Long Jump](/action/long-jump-player-core). The first time each round you [Sustain](/action/sustain-player-core) the Spell, you can move the churning area up to 20 feet in any direction. Creatures immobilized by the spell are carried along with the shifting sand in the same direction, if possible. Creatures that enter or begin their turn standing in the shifting sand must attempt a Reflex save.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected and ignores the area’s difficult terrain and penalty to skill checks until the end of its turn.

**Success** The creature ignores the area’s penalty to skill checks until the end of its turn.

**Failure** The creature is affected normally by the spell this turn.

**Critical Failure** The creature becomes [immobilized](/condition/immobilized-player-core) within the spell’s area until it [Escapes](/action/escape-player-core). If the creature was already immobilized by shifting sand, it also falls [prone](/condition/prone-player-core).

---
**Heightened (5th)** The status penalty increases to –2, and the spell’s range increases to 60 feet.

**Heightened (7th)** The status penalty increases to –3, the spell’s range increases to 60 feet, and the spell’s area increases to a 30-foot burst.

**Heightened (9th)** The status penalty increases to –4, the spell’s range increases to 60 feet, and the spell’s area increases to a 40-foot burst

data.area: a horizontal earthen or sandy surface within a 20-foot burst

name: Shockwave
descr:
**Deities**
[Ayrzul](/deity/ayrzul-the-fossilized-king-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-687), [Mhar](/deity/mhar-the-world-thunder-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-571), [Mugura and Nrithu](/deity/mugura-and-nrithu-the-divine-dancers-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-300), [Orgesh](/deity/orgesh-the-faceless-god-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-576), [Ragdya](/deity/ragdya-the-sage-on-the-mountain-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-618), [Yamatsumi](/deity/yamatsumi-the-mountain-lord-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-319), [Zipacna](/deity/zipacna-the-mountain-below-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-604)

**Area** 15-foot [cone](/rule/cone-rules-2386)

---

You create a wave of energy that ripples through the earth. Terrestrial creatures in the affected area must attempt a Reflex save to avoid stumbling as the shockwave shakes the ground.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature is [off-guard](/condition/off-guard-player-core) until the start of its next turn.

**Failure** The creature falls [prone](/condition/prone-player-core).

**Critical Failure** As failure, plus the creature takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage.

---
**Heightened (+1)** The area increases by 5 feet (to a 20-foot cone at 2nd rank, and so on).

name: Show the Path
descr:
**Domain**
[Naga](/domain/naga-divine-mysteries-domain-domain-113)

---

You grant the target insight on things to come, guiding them toward a fate they find most fitting and encouraging them to continue this journey. The creature rolls a d20 at the start of each of its turns. The creature can use the result of the roll instead of rolling for any check before the start of their next turn. If the creature does substitute the roll in this way, they gain a +1 status bonus to whatever check they substitute on the following turn. Repeated substitutions increase the status bonus by 1, up to a total of +2. If the creature begins their turn without having substituted a roll in the previous round, the spell ends.

---
**Heightened (7th)** The status bonus can increase up to a total of +3.

**Heightened (10th)** The status bonus can increase up to a total of +4.

name: Show The Way
descr:
**Area** 20-foot [emanation](/rule/emanation-rules-2387)

---

You and allies in the area gain preternatural knowledge of the path ahead, allowing you to intuit the best way forward and avoid potential obstacles, such as difficult or confusing terrain. For the purpose of long-distance overland [travel](/rule/travel-rules-2580) during exploration mode, traveling through difficult terrain reduces you to only three-quarters your travel Speed instead of half, and traveling through greater difficult terrain reduces your travel Speed to only half your travel Speed instead of one-third. Show the way doesn’t prevent you from falling into traps or encountering other artificial obstacles and hazards.

---
**Heightened (6th)** For the purpose of long-distance overland travel during exploration mode, traveling through difficult terrain doesn’t reduce your travel Speed at all, and traveling through greater difficult terrain reduces your travel Speed to only three-quarters of its normal value instead of one-third.

name: Slough Skin
descr:
**Deities**
[Diomazul](/deity/diomazul-the-serpent-of-eighty-blades-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-614), [Narakaas](/deity/narakaas-the-cleansing-sentence-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-672), [Urazra](/deity/urazra-breaker-of-bones-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-499), [Vildeis](/deity/vildeis-the-cardinal-martyr-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-487), [Yig](/deity/yig-father-of-serpents-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-579)

---

You continually and harmlessly slough off the top layer of your skin while new skin regenerates immediately, quickly moving damaging substances away from your body. The flat check to remove [persistent damage](/condition/persistent-damage-player-core) from effects that coat your skin (such as most persistent acid damage) is reduced to 5, and you gain a +2 status bonus to your initial save against contact [poison](/trait/poison) (but not to further saves since, by that point, the toxin has already entered your system). If you’re affected by an effect other than persistent damage that depends on continuous contact with your skin, and if that effect allows a saving throw, you receive a new saving throw against that effect at the end of each turn when you attempt your flat checks against persistent damage, and you also receive a +2 status bonus to those saving throws.

While affected by this spell, your continually shedding skin makes you much easier to Track. Anyone [Tracking](/action/track-player-core) you gains a +2 circumstance bonus to do so, and you can’t Hide Your Tracks.

name: Spirit Object
descr:
**Patron Theme**
Baba Yaga

---

Using a sliver of Baba Yaga’s power, you briefly bring a nearby object to life. The object gains a means of locomotion if it does not already have one, such as sprouting chicken legs, and [Strides](/action/stride-player-core) up to 25 feet to a space you decide within range. Once per round, you can [Sustain](/action/sustain-player-core) the spell to command the object further, either prompting it to move again or to [Strike](/action/strike-player-core). If prompted to move, the object Strides up to 25 feet again to a space within 30 feet of you. If prompted to Strike, the object attacks one creature of your choice adjacent to its space. Make a melee [spell attack](/rule/spell-attacks-rules-2248) roll against the creature. On a success, the creature takes 2d4 damage. The damage is either bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, as appropriate for the object. The object doesn’t do anything if it doesn’t receive further commands from you. If you cast _spirit object_ again, any previously affected object reverts back to normal. You can [Dismiss](/action/dismiss-player-core) the spell.

---
**Heightened (+1)** Increase the maximum Bulk of the target by 1 and the damage by 2d4.

name: Stasis
descr:
**Domain**
[Time](/domain/time-divine-mysteries-domain-domain-121)

---

The flow of time congeals around an object or creature, holding it in place. The target must attempt a Will save (an unattended object automatically critically fails its save).

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target is [stunned](/condition/stunned-player-core) 1 as time thickens around it.

**Failure** Time ceases to pass for the target for 1 round.
