It is invulnerable to all damage, it can’t be targeted or affected by anything, and no rounds elapse for any timed durations, conditions, afflictions, and other effects it has. While in stasis, the target can’t be moved, and it remains fixed in place, defying gravity if need be.

**Critical Failure** As failure, but the target is held in stasis for 3 rounds. At the end of each of its turns, it can attempt a Will save to reduce the remaining duration by 1 round or end it entirely on a critical success.

data.targets: 1 creature or up to 1 Bulk of objects

name: Swarm Form
descr:
**Domain**
[Swarm](/domain/swarm-divine-mysteries-domain-domain-120)

---

You discorporate into a swarm of Tiny creatures. While in swarm form, you are the same size, you have the [swarm](/trait/swarm) trait and you gain [resistance](/rule/immunity-weakness-and-resistance-rules-2312) 5 to slashing and piercing damage and weakness 5 to area and [splash](/trait/splash) damage. You can fit into spaces only a few inches wide, moving your constituent creatures through the gap, and you can share a space with another creature. You don’t gain the swarm mind ability, so you are still affected normally by mental effects. As a swarm, you can’t speak, [cast spells](/action/cast-a-spell-player-core), use [manipulate](/trait/manipulate) actions requiring your hands, activate your magic items, or make any of your [Strikes](/rule/strikes-rules-2895) with your normal body. While in swarm form, you can crawl all over any creature that shares your space as a single action. That creature must attempt a Fortitude save against your spell DC or become [sickened](/condition/sickened-player-core) 1 (sickened 2 on a critical failure). You can [Dismiss](/action/dismiss-player-core) the Spell.

---
**Heightened (+2)** Your resistances and weaknesses each increase by 5.

name: Swarmsense
descr:
**Domain**
[Swarm](/domain/swarm-divine-mysteries-domain-domain-120)

---

You extend your senses through a multitude of crawling and flying creatures. You create a crawling swarm in your square. You can hear through the swarm as if using your normal auditory senses. When you [Cast this Spell](/action/cast-a-spell-player-core) and the first time you [Sustain](/action/sustain-player-core) it each round, you can move the swarm 10 feet along the ground in any direction. The swarm has AC 15 and a +0 bonus to its saves. Any damage dealt to the swarm destroys it and ends the spell.

---
**Heightened (3rd)** The swarm has a [climb Speed](/rule/climb-speed-rules-2349) of 10 feet.

**Heightened (5th)** The swarm has a [fly Speed](/rule/fly-speed-rules-2350) of 10 feet. You can see through the swarm using your visual senses.

**Heightened (7th)** The swarm gains a 10-foot status bonus to its Speeds.

name: Swear Oath
descr:
**Domain**
[Duty](/domain/duty-divine-mysteries-domain-domain-108)

---

You loudly and firmly state a course of action that you swear to fulfill. When you [Cast this Spell](/action/cast-a-spell-player-core), [Ready](/action/ready-player-core) a single action or free action you can use. If the action is in line with your personal edicts or the edicts presented by your [religion](/rule/religion-rules-2976), you can Cast this Spell as a single action. If the trigger you designate occurs and you can use the chosen action as a reaction, you gain a +1 status bonus to any attack roll or skill check required. If the trigger you designate doesn’t occur, you can [Sustain](/action/sustain-player-core) the spell on your next turn to regain the Focus Point spent for this spell.

---
**Heightened (5th)** The status bonus is +2.

**Heightened (9th)** The status bonus is +3.

name: Temporal Distortion
descr:
**There is a more recent version of this, click here to view.**

**Mystery**
Time

---

You share some of your own temporal distortions with a foe, altering their mind and body unpredictably as they’re thrown backward or forward in time. Roll 1d4. On a 1, the foe becomes [clumsy](/condition/clumsy-player-core); on a 2, it becomes [enfeebled](/condition/enfeebled-player-core); on a 3, it becomes [stupefied](/condition/stupefied-player-core); and on a 4, you choose which condition applies.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target is either clumsy 1, enfeebled 1, or stupefied 1 for 1 round, depending on the result of the d4.

**Failure** The target is either clumsy 1, enfeebled 1, or stupefied 1 for 4 rounds, depending on the result of the d4.

**Critical Failure** As failure, but the time warp is stronger, increasing the condition’s effects but making it run its course faster. The condition’s value is 3, and the condition lasts for 2 rounds.

name: Temporary Tool
descr:
**Deities**
[Amaznen](/deity/amaznen-the-father-of-invention-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-404), [Bharnarol](/deity/bharnarol-the-tempered-inventor-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-467), [Brigh](/deity/brigh-the-whisper-in-bronze-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-333), [Findeladlara](/deity/findeladlara-the-guiding-hand-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-461), [Magrim](/deity/magrim-the-taskmaster-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-450), [Ptah](/deity/ptah-lord-of-eternity-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-638), [Wheels of Innovation](/deity/wheels-of-innovation-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-385), [Zogmugot](/deity/zogmugot-lady-lastbreath-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-508)

---

You conjure a temporary simple tool, such as a shovel or [rope](/item/rope-player-core) into your hands. It lasts until it’s used for a single activity or for 1 minute, whichever comes first, after which it disappears. The tool is obviously temporarily conjured and thus can’t be sold or passed off as a genuine item.

name: Tether
descr:
**Deities**
[Dispater](/deity/dispater-iron-lord-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-397), [Shivaska](/deity/shivaska-the-chained-maiden-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-436)

---

You use magical chains, vines, or other tethers to bind your target to you. The creature can still try to [Escape](/action/escape-player-core), and it or others can break the tethers by attacking them (the tethers have AC 15 and 10 Hit Points). You must stay within 30 feet of the target while it’s tethered; moving more than 30 feet away from your target ends the spell. The target must attempt a Reflex save. You can [Dismiss](/action/dismiss-player-core) the spell.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target takes a –5-foot circumstance penalty to its Speed as long as it’s within 30 feet of you.

**Failure** The target takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speed and can’t move more than 30 feet away from you until it Escapes or the spell ends.

**Critical Failure** The target is [immobilized](/condition/immobilized-player-core) until it Escapes or the spell ends.

---
**Heightened (+1)** The tethers’ AC increases by 3, and their Hit Points increase by 10.

name: Time Beacon
descr:
**There is a more recent version of this, click here to view.**

_**PFS Note** Organized play does not allow this spell. Instead, substitute [_true target_](/spell/true-target-player-core)._

**Traditions**
Arcane, Occult

**Deities**
[Shyka](/deity/shyka-the-many-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-460), [Yog-Sothoth](/deity/yog-sothoth-lurker-at-the-threshold-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-580)

**Duration** until the end of your turn

---

You create a beacon in time to return to it if things go wrong. You can cast _time beacon_ only on your turn. Keep careful track of everything that happens this turn after you cast time beacon. At the end of your turn, you can choose to rewind time back to just after you cast _time beacon_, removing all effects of your turn since then. [Curses](/rule/curses-rules-2766), traps, and other harmful effects that happen during your turn might prevent you from returning to the beacon if they’re powerful enough. If you were affected by any harmful effects during your turn after casting _time beacon_, in order to return to your beacon, _time beacon_ attempts a [counteract](/rule/counteracting-rules-3280) check against each such effect. If it fails at any of these checks, you can’t return. After returning to the _time beacon_, the spell ends.

name: Time Skip
descr:
**There is a more recent version of this, click here to view.**

**Mystery**
Time

---

You manipulate time around your ally, pushing them forward a few moments in time. The target is [quickened](/condition/quickened-player-core) on its next turn and can use the action only to [Step](/action/step-player-core), [Stride](/action/stride-player-core), or [Strike](/action/strike-player-core).

---
**Heightened (6th)** You can affect up to four willing creatures other than yourself within range.

name: Tireless Worker
descr:
**Domain**
[Toil](/domain/toil-divine-mysteries-domain-domain-122)

---

You suppress your choice of one of the following conditions that’s affecting the target: [clumsy](/condition/clumsy-player-core), [encumbered](/condition/encumbered-player-core), [enfeebled](/condition/enfeebled-player-core), or [fatigued](/condition/fatigued-player-core). The duration of the condition doesn’t elapse while it is suppressed, so if you don’t remove the effect that caused the condition, the condition returns after the spell’s duration expires.

name: Trade Death for Life
descr:
**Patron Theme**
Paradox of Opposites

---

Your patron steals life from one of your enemies to grant it to another. The target takes 1d4 [void](/trait/void) damage (basic Fortitude save). If the target takes damage, a willing creature within the hex’s range gains fast healing 1 for as long as you [Sustain](/action/sustain-player-core) the hex. The target takes damage only once from this spell, whether or not you Sustain it.

---
**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d4 and the fast healing increases by 1.

name: Ulcerous Canker
descr:
**Mystery**
Blight

---

Weeping sores open on the target as you expose it to decay, dealing 1d4 [void](/trait/void) damage and 1d4 [poison](/trait/poison) damage plus 1 [persistent bleed damage](/condition/persistent-damage-player-core). The target must attempt a Fortitude save.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target takes half the initial damage and no persistent bleed damage.

**Failure** The target takes full damage.

**Critical Failure** The creature takes double initial damage and double persistent bleed damage.

---
**Heightened (+2)** The void damage and poison damage each increase by 1d4, and the persistent bleed damage increases by 2.

name: Wall of Radiance
descr:
**Deity**
[Sturovenen](/deity/sturovenen-the-dragoneagle-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-523)

---

You create a thin wall of brilliant light in a straight line up to 60 feet long and 10 feet high. You must create the wall in an unbroken open space so its edges don’t pass through any creatures or objects, or the spell is lost. The wall stands vertically and, if you wish, can be of a shorter length or height. Creatures adjacent to the wall are [dazzled](/condition/dazzled-player-core). Creatures that move through the wall take 2d6 fire damage (basic Fortitude save) as the concentrated light burns them.

---
**Heightened (4th)** The [light](/trait/light) makes it difficult to discern creatures on the other side. Creatures are [concealed](/condition/concealed-player-core) to other creatures on the opposite side of the wall from them. The fire damage increases to 3d6.

name: Wall of Shadow
descr:
**Deities**
[Aleth](/deity/aleth-the-gentle-shroud-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-328), [Children of the Night](/deity/children-of-the-night-divine-mysteries-deity-deity-376)

---

You form a wall of pure darkness in a straight line up to 60 feet long and 10 feet high. You must create the wall in an unbroken open space so its edges don’t pass through any creatures or objects, or the spell is lost. The wall stands vertically and, if you wish, can be of a shorter length or height. The wall prevents light from passing through and appears as a sheet of pure darkness to creatures observing it. Creatures without [darkvision](/rule/darkvision-and-greater-darkvision-rules-2410) or those unable to see through darkness can’t see creatures on the other side of the wall. The wall is too thin for creatures to Hide in the darkness itself, but creatures can [Hide](/action/hide-player-core) from creatures on the other side of the wall as normal.

---
**Heightened (5th)** Creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the wall. They treat targets seen through the wall as [concealed](/condition/concealed-player-core).

**Heightened (7th)** Creatures with greater darkvision can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the wall as concealed. All other creatures are unable to see through the darkness at all.

name: Whirling Scarves
descr:
You surround yourself in a vortex of whirling colorful scarves of force that obfuscate you and disorient your foes. You gain the benefits of the [concealed](/condition/concealed-player-core) condition, but only against ranged and melee attacks. When a melee attack fails to hit you because of the flat check for the concealed condition, the scarves snag the weapon or unarmed attack, and the creature takes a –1 circumstance penalty to further attacks with that weapon or unarmed attack until the end of its turn (or the end of its next turn, if it wasn’t the creature’s turn). The timing of the scarves’ movement is harder to predict for ranged attackers, so the [flat check](/rule/checks-rules-2278) for the concealed condition against ranged attacks increases from DC 5 to DC 6. You can Dismiss this spell.

---
**Heightened (+2)** The circumstance penalty to further attacks with a melee weapon or unarmed attack the scarves snag increases by 1. The DC of the flat check for the concealed condition against ranged attacks increases by 1.

name: Winter Bolt
descr:
**Domain**
[Cold](/domain/cold-divine-mysteries-domain-domain-103)

**Defense**
AC

---

You fling a hollow icicle filled with winter’s wrath. Make a [spell attack](/rule/spell-attacks-rules-2248) against the target’s AC. The bolt deals 1d8 piercing damage and lodges in the target. At the end of the target’s next turn, the bolt shatters, releasing a whirl of snow and ice that deals 1d12 [cold](/trait/cold) damage to the target and all adjacent creatures. The bolt can be removed with an Interact action, which causes it to melt harmlessly without detonating.

**Critical Success** The initial bolt deals full damage and is especially well anchored, taking 2 [Interact](/action/interact-player-core) actions to remove. The bolt’s explosion deals double damage.

**Success** The bolt and its explosion deal full damage.

---
**Heightened (+1)** The bolt’s initial damage increases by 1d8 and the explosion damage increases by 1d12.

name: Withering Grasp
descr:
**Domain**
[Decay](/domain/decay-divine-mysteries-domain-domain-104)

**Defense**
AC

---

Your touch rots organic material and decays objects. Make a spell attack against the target’s AC. Your touch deals 1d12 [void](/trait/void) damage plus 1d4 [persistent void damage](/condition/persistent-damage-player-core). If a creature uses an item to block withering grasp, such as with the [Shield Block](/feat/shield-block-player-core) reaction, the item is automatically affected, but the creature doesn’t take damage (even if there is damage left over after the shield’s [Hardness](/rule/hardness-rules-2183)). Unlike normal void damage, the void damage from _withering grasp_ damages [objects](/rule/objects-rules-2363), [constructs](/trait/construct), and the like by eroding away their substance.

**Critical Success** Your touch deals double damage (both initial and persistent). If you target an object, lower its Hardness by 4 for 1 minute.

**Success** Your touch deals full damage. If you target an object, lower its Hardness by 2 for 1 minute.

---
**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d12 and the persistent damage increases by 1. If you target an object, lower its Hardness by an additional 1 point on both a success and a critical success.

name: Wood Walk
descr:
**Domain**
[Wood](/domain/wood-divine-mysteries-domain-domain-124)

---

Wood shapes itself according to your will readily, making staircases appear as you climb up the side of a tree, automatically weaving vines into ladders, or lowering branches to lift you up to the top. When you [Cast this Spell](/action/cast-a-spell-player-core), move up to your Speed in any direction or along any surface, so long as there are living plants or trees of size Large or larger within 15 feet of you. The wood allows you to move but doesn’t protect you from hazardous terrain or other dangers. Each time you [Sustain](/action/sustain-player-core) this spell, you can move again in the same way.

---
**Heightened (8th)** The duration of this spell becomes 10 minutes. You no longer need to Sustain the spell to extend its duration, but you can Sustain it to move as described.

name: Zenith Star
descr:
**Domain**
[Star](/domain/star-divine-mysteries-domain-domain-119)

---

You call a tiny star to orbit a creature in a sparkling halo before shooting up into the heavens, where it marks the creature’s rough location. The target must attempt a Fortitude save.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target is [dazzled](/condition/dazzled-player-core) for 1 round.

**Failure** The target is dazzled for 1 round. While the spell persists, as long as you can see the night sky and the target is visible from the same night sky, you can sense the approximate direction and distance to the creature by [Sustaining](/action/sustain-player-core) the spell. This is enough to track the creature, but not pinpoint their exact square (for instance, to make an attack). You can set a number of zenith stars equal to your Wisdom modifier; if you exceed this number, your oldest zenith star is automatically [Dismissed](/action/dismiss-player-core).

**Critical Failure** As failure, but the target is [blinded](/condition/blinded-player-core) for 1 round.

---
**Heightened (+1)** The duration increases by 1 day.

**Heightened (4th)** You ignore the [concealed](/condition/concealed-player-core) condition against targets marked by zenith star.
